BiblicalUsage: Na'aphuph is adultery, the noun, and its one occurrence is God speaking to faithless Israel. In Hosea 2:2 the Lord tells the people to plead with their mother, to put away her adulteries from between her breasts, because she is not His wife and He is not her husband.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the harshest word in Hosea is also the most honest one, because God names the sin before He offers the return; He will not call it anything softer than it is.
